newsitem.title: GREECE: CITIBANK LAUNCHES NEW HOUSING LOAN AT FIXED 16.0PCT.
newsitem.headline: CITIBANK LAUNCHES NEW HOUSING LOAN AT FIXED 16.0PCT.

text.p: Citibank launched a new five-year, fixed-rate housing loan at 16.0 percent for amounts up to 10 million drachmas, it said in a statement.
The loan can be used to purchase land or a home and does not necessitate collateralisation of the asset.

Under Citibank's 'new banking relationship', clients with outstanding deposit balances in excess of 5.0 million drachmas are offered housing loan rates reduced by 1.0 percent, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
